description: This file defines the GraphLoader object in the org.apache.spark.graphx package, providing utility functions to load graphs from edge list files into Spark GraphX. It includes the method 'edgeListFile' which reads a file, processes edge data, and constructs a graph with specified storage levels and options.

classes.name: GraphLoader
classes.description: Object providing utilities for loading Graphs from files, specifically edge list formatted files.

methods.name: edgeListFile
methods.description: Loads a graph from an edge list file, parsing lines to create edges, optionally orienting edges, and returning a Graph object with specified storage levels.
